g.text: These colonies ran on a sunset moved by four hours and seasons moved by six months, and they followed it. Half of all
A. loripes releases fall within 5 minutes. In the wild, with places and species mixed, Acropora spreads over 84.
In the tanks, each species keeps its own time
Dots: one genus on one reef-night (wild) or one tagged colony on one night (tanks), nudged apart so they stay visible; the number of records is in brackets. Cream bar: the middle half of each row.
Tank times count from the programmed sunset, 2022–23. Sources: Baird et al. (2021); Koukoumaftsis et al. (2025), supplementary Table S1.
